name: AutoDock-GPU
summary: Accelerated AutoDock4-style protein-ligand docking on supported CPU/GPU backends.

steps: Read the official AutoDock-GPU build guide and choose the supported OpenCL or CUDA backend for the user's hardware.
Check compiler, accelerator SDK, include/library paths and intended work-group size before building in a user-owned directory.
Verify the generated backend-specific executable and its help output; receptor maps and ligand PDBQT preparation are separate workflows.
install.verify_note: Check the compiled autodock_<type>_<N>wi executable and maintainer example only after GPU and input-preparation review.

notes: This is distinct from AutoDock Vina. Building and running a GPU backend requires host-specific drivers/toolkits and cannot be safely generalized as a one-command install.
